## MCP - Documents Process (RFC-014 Phase 2)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/documents/process

**Purpose:** Process document with async callback

**RFC-014 Input Structure:**
```json
{
  "job_id": "uuid",
  "context": {
    "file_url": "https://..." OR "file_base64": "...",
    "action": "translate|summarize|ocr",
    "params": { "target_language": "fr" }
  },
  "plugin_context": { "api_keys": {...} },
  "callback_url": "https://..."
}
```

**Legacy Input (also supported):**
```json
{
  "job_id": "uuid",
  "file_url": "https://...",
  "action": "translate",
  "params": {...},
  "callback_url": "..."
}
```

**Response:** Immediate ACK with job_id, result via callback
